_comment: Apify Store actors per job board. input: the actor's INPUT, with {query} {location} {country} {limit} placeholders ({limit} becomes a number; a placeholder with no value drops its key). defaults fill placeholders the CLI flags leave empty. fields: candidate output paths per contract field, first non-empty wins. Input/output names differ per actor and change over time: confirm against the actor's Input and Output tabs on apify.com, then run one search with -n 3 before relying on a board.

indeed._verified: Checked 2026-11-16. Input schema: position, country (enum incl. IN, DE, LU), location, maxItemsPerSearch, parseCompanyDetails, saveOnlyUniqueItems. Pricing: pay-per-event, $0.006 per listing on the free tier (20 listings = $0.12). Output confirmed by a 3-listing run (engineering manager, IN, Bengaluru): positionName, company, location, url (in.indeed.com/viewjob?jk=), id, postingDateParsed (ISO; postedAt was null), salary (often null), jobType (array), isExpired, externalApplyLink, description, descriptionHTML.

naukri._disabled_reason: naukri.com's robots.txt disallows Claude user agents (search-queries.md). Running a third-party scraper there routes around a site that said no, which this workspace's robots rule (09-web-research.md) does not do. Enable only as your own informed choice.
